labels: PREDICTIVE INCREMENTAL-VALUE ANALYSIS (out-of-fold; Vt-side inputs only)
RETROSPECTIVE MOLECULAR ASSOCIATION / INTERACTION - NOT PREDICTIVE VALIDATION
interpretation: RNA = baseline / as-of-sample tumour biology (latest sample at or before Vt), NOT current-state RNA and NOT causal. Treatment = class active AT Vt.
rule: primary >=150 pts & >=150 events & >=150 non-events (group AND complement); exploratory >=80 pts & >=75 events & >=75 non-events; multiclass >=20 rows/class
